standard_prerequisites.name: The equivalence between sheaves on the localized site and sheaves on a slice
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the categories of sheaves on the localized sites with the slices, which is what makes the description of the pullback meaningful.

standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identifications used to compare the composites of lower shriek and pullback.

core_obligations: Adjunction and the easy identity (proof lines 6511-6526): continuity of the restricted functor gives the pushforward and its adjoint, and the identity relating the restricted pushforward to the pushforward and the localization functor is computed on values, where it holds even for presheaves.

Description of the pullback (proof lines 6529-6562): the author computes the composite of the lower shriek with the restricted pullback, uses the computation of the lower shriek of a localization twice and the relation between the functors on the localized sites, and hence obtains a commutative diagram which identifies the restricted pullback with the pullback on slices, giving the displayed formula.

Exactness and the morphism of sites (proof lines 6563-6576): since the horizontal arrows of that diagram are equivalences and the pullback is exact, the restricted pullback is exact by the criterion for left exact functors between left adjoints, so the restricted functor is a morphism of sites.

The last identity (proof lines 6579-6596): the pullback of the localization functor is identified by the same formula and the computation of the lower shriek of a restriction, and the equivalence property of the lower shriek concludes.
proof_roadmap: Check continuity of the restricted functor and compute the relation between the restricted pushforward and the pushforward.
Compute the lower shriek of the restricted pullback to identify the restricted pullback with the pullback on slices.
Deduce exactness from the equivalence of the slices with the localized sheaves, and finish with the formula for the pullback of the localization functor.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism of sites restricts to a morphism between the localized sites, fits into the expected commutative diagram of topoi, has its pullback described by the pullback on slices under the identification of the localized categories of sheaves with the slices, and satisfies the identity relating the pullback of the localization functor to the localization of the pullback (statement lines 6481-6509). The proof is a complete argument: continuity and the valuewise identity are treated first (proof lines 6511-6526); the description of the pullback is obtained by computing the lower shriek of the composite and using the two companion identifications (proof lines 6529-6562); exactness and the morphism-of-sites property follow from the equivalence of the slices with the localized sheaves and the criterion for exactness of left adjoints (proof lines 6563-6576); and the final identity is proved by the same computation (proof lines 6579-6596). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two pullbacks through the lower shriek. The claim is H2: a structured computation with each input named.
